value.heading: Our Story
value.lead: We are a small team of planners, builders and helpers. We set up the tools a business runs on, move its data into them, and stay around after launch so the team can grow with them.

value.html:
About Us

Welcome to Example Co, a part of Example Group, which sets up work tools for teams. From the first plan to set-up and custom apps to connecting the tools you already use, we do it all for you.

To help small businesses and large ones run smoothly, our team brings years of practice and a love of tidy systems to every project, and shapes each one around your goals. 

Our Mission

We help businesses of every size work with less friction: fewer copies of the same data, fewer manual steps and clearer hand-offs. Our team turns many separate systems and spreadsheets into one work platform that fits your business. 

Our Commitment

Our work does not stop at launch. We want you to be happy with the result and to use every part of it. We build long relationships on trust and plain talk, learn your goals and keep working until the tools fit. 

Why Work With Us?

When you pick us, you pick a partner who cares about your success. There is more than one reason to work with us:

Experience

Our team has hands-on experience with work platforms and the services around them, so you get solutions shaped to the way your business runs. 

People First

Your team comes first. We take the time to understand your business and its problems so that the result meets your needs. 

A Long Record

With 120 clients served, you can count on faster workflows, automation that saves time and a team that works well together. 

Always Learning

Our specialists and developers keep up with new tools and ideas, and keep looking for new ways to make our clients’ work simpler.
